sourcePrompt: Generate with a code agent Todo List composable app with all required schema types. A simple Todo List app is a lightweight tool for managing everyday tasks in Creatio. It allows users to create and maintain a list of tasks, see them in a structured list view, update their status, and manage task details throughout their lifecycle.

businessOutcome.value: Personal task tracking tool enabling users to create, view, and manage tasks with status visibility and priority management

actorsAndRoles.value: Individual users managing their own personal tasks

domainModel.value: UsrTodo (main entity with Title, Description, Status, Priority, DueDate), UsrTodoStatus lookup (New, In Progress, Completed), UsrTodoPriority lookup (Low, Medium, High)

lifecycleAndStatuses.value: Status transitions: New → In Progress → Completed (no restrictions on transitions)

businessRules.value: Title mandatory, Status defaults to New, Priority defaults to Medium, standard CRUD permissions, no transition restrictions

uxExpectations.value: List page shows Title, Status, Priority, DueDate. Form page shows all fields with standard vertical layout.

edgeCases.value: No special edge cases - standard validation applies (required fields, valid lookups)

acceptanceCriteria.value: Users can create tasks with title/description/priority/due date, view tasks in list, update status and details in form, see all fields properly displayed
